item.tib: ma cig srid pa rgyal mo'i gsang skong zlog bsad mdos kyi 'phyong chen rin chen sgron me
item.coloph: de ltar ye shes mkha' 'gro mas/ zhal lung bstan pa ji bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bris pa dge dam ldan yongs kyi grogs su shog 'gro la phan pa'i rgyu gyur cig dam med rnams la u ya tham/ sa ma ya/ rgyargyargya//
